name: downwash
description: Control the installed DownWash app with its normal previews and Full Unlock.
long_description: A thin local connector to the installed DownWash macOS app's bundled native MCP helper. All seven tools run through the app, using its actual free preview, verified Full Unlock, file permissions and processing consent. Full telemetry, reports, artifact retrieval and video operations follow the app's paid entitlement policy; purchase actions require fresh human approval in the app and the normal store flow. No standalone processor or hosted upload service is included. Requires native automation introduced in DownWash 1.0.1 build 11, submitted for store review; install the released update before using this connector.

helper_path.title: DownWash app MCP helper
helper_path.description: Absolute path to downwash-mcp inside the installed DownWash.app. This connects to the app and uses its normal free and paid policies.
